title: 第23章 这世间天骄当真如过江之鲫不巧这是真龙第24章 我家老婆真可爱
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
另外一头，叶天澜已经在家族核心令牌的加持之下，一路畅通无阻的来到了功法大殿的顶层。
这里的空间比他想象中的还要稍微大上一些。
打扫的干净整齐，常年设有避尘的阵法维持着原样。
不过却没有下两层那般密集的书架排列了。
只有一座座由特殊材质打造而成的石台横亘在中央，醒目无比。
粗略看去只有六乘六三十六座。
而且其中不少石台都是空着的，只有一半多一点，也就二十种功法陈列在此。
叶天澜走上前开始一部接一部的阅览起来。
有着核心令牌在手，他的时间很多，反正没人催他，可以全部慢悠悠的查看一番，直到挑选一部合适的剑法出来。
没错，他的打算便是修炼剑法，这可比单纯的挥剑快多了。
要是可以找到一部以速度见长的剑法的话，他完全可以在短时间内就把那凤血蛭的血液给挥发干净。
一路看下去叶天澜都没有找到合适称心的，被收录在这里的基本上都是功法，像是秘籍武技反而少一些，只占有不到三分之一的数量。
就在叶天澜心中略感失望之际，一部名为苍松剑典的剑道秘籍吸引了他的注意力。
苍松剑典，七式四十二剑！
而其中的第三式松涛拍岸，以极高的剑法频率震动剑身，引动周遭天地气流，形成层层剑气风浪，从效果而言，刚好完美符合他的要求。
“就这个了！”他眼神一亮。
就在叶天澜怀抱苍松剑典准备转身离开之际，眼神瞥见了在那最后排的石台上还摆放着一枚残破不堪的竹简。
呈现出黯淡无光的模样，还有着深黑色的污垢沾染在上面，一副尚且出土不久的模样。
和前面石台上摆放着的光鲜亮丽秘籍宝典形成了鲜明对比。
“这是什么？”

叶天澜心中好奇，便快步走上前去将其拿起。
入手倒是没有想象中的沉重，反倒是十分的轻盈，破碎的摩挲感从指尖传来，像是干燥的泥土沙子。
叶天澜放弃触及的感受，眼神被那竹简的内容给深深的吸引住了。
“丹道真解···”
“入门篇。”
就在这时，他神色一动，下意识的看向进来的门户所在处。
就见一道身影极速掠过，随后出现在他的面前，不由分说的就是拉起他的手腕，焦急询问道：
“小天澜，你还没有修炼功法吧？”
叶天澜有些懵逼的啊了一声。
“三长老，您，这是什么意思···”
“我才刚刚挑选完，还没来得及修炼呢。”
三长老眼神一瞟，注意到他怀中抱着的两样东西，这才松了口气，被狂风吹的僵硬的胡须又软了下去。
“苍松剑典啊，不错不错，这门剑法倒是挺适合你的，中正温和···”
“嗯？这玩意儿怎么又被放出来了，这竹简上什么都没有记载，要不是看其材质不凡，还是被祖宗从那出宗门遗迹中带出来的话，早就给当成垃圾扔了。”
“小天澜，你要不要换一个试试？”
三长老循循善诱道。
叶天澜愣在了原地，甚至连后半句话都没有去注意。
他在乎的无非是那句，“这竹简上什么都没有记载”。
他有些不可置信的低头再度摊开竹简看了看，略做犹豫之后将其展示在三长老面前晃了晃。
这些长辈视他如己出，至今为止他的身份都还保护的好好的，所以他选择相信。
content_en:
On the other side, with the blessing of the family's core token, Ye Tianlan had reached the top floor of the Kung Fu Hall unimpeded.
The space here is slightly larger than he imagined.
It is kept clean and tidy, and the dust-shielding formations set up all year round are maintained as they are.
However, there are no as densely arranged bookshelves as the lower two floors.
There are only stone platforms made of special materials standing in the center, which are extremely eye-catching.
At a rough glance, there are only six by six thirty-six seats.
Moreover, many of the stone platforms are empty, with only a little more than half of them, and only twenty exercises displayed here.
Ye Tianlan stepped forward and started reading one book after another.
With the core token in hand, he has a lot of time. Since no one is urging him, he can slowly check them all until he chooses a suitable sword technique.
That's right, his plan is to practice swordsmanship, which is much faster than simply swinging a sword.
If he could find a sword technique that was good at speed, he could completely volatilize the blood of the phoenix blood leech in a short time.
Ye Tianlan kept looking all the way but couldn't find anything that suited his needs. Basically, the ones included here were all exercises. For example, there were fewer secrets on martial arts, accounting for less than one-third of the total.
Just when Ye Tianlan felt a little disappointed, a kendo secret book called Cangsong Sword Code attracted his attention.
Cangsong Sword Code, seven styles and forty-two swords!
Among them, the third style, Pine Waves Crash on the Shore, vibrates the sword body with extremely high sword frequency, triggering the surrounding air currents of heaven and earth, forming layers of sword energy waves. In terms of effect, it perfectly meets his requirements.
"That's it!" His eyes lit up.
Just when Ye Tianlan was about to turn around and leave with Cangsong Jiandian in his arms, he caught a glimpse of a broken bamboo slip placed on the stone platform in the last row.
It had a dull appearance, with deep black dirt stained on it, as if it had been unearthed not long ago.
It is in sharp contrast to the glossy secret book on the stone platform in front.
"What is this?"
Ye Tianlan was curious, so he quickly walked forward and picked it up.
It is not as heavy as expected when I hold it, but is actually very light. A crushing rubbing sensation comes from my fingertips, like dry soil and sand.
Ye Tianlan gave up the touching feeling, and his eyes were deeply attracted by the content of the bamboo slip.
"The True Explanation of Alchemy..."
"Introduction."
At this moment, his expression changed, and he subconsciously looked towards the entrance door.
He saw a figure passing by very quickly, and then appeared in front of him. Without any explanation, he took his wrist and asked anxiously:
"Xiao Tianlan, you haven't practiced the skills yet, have you?"
Ye Tianlan let out a confused sound.
"Third Elder, what do you mean..."
"I just finished selecting, and I haven't had time to practice yet."
The third elder glanced and noticed the two things he was holding in his arms. Then he breathed a sigh of relief, and his stiff beard softened by the strong wind.
"Cangsong Sword Code, it's not bad. This swordsmanship is quite suitable for you. Zhongzheng is gentle..."
"Huh? Why was this thing released again? There is nothing recorded on this bamboo slip. If it weren't for its extraordinary material, or if it was taken out by the ancestors from the ruins of the sect, it would have been thrown away as garbage long ago."
"Xiao Tianlan, do you want to try another one?"
The three elders follow the path of good guidance.
Ye Tianlan froze on the spot, not even paying attention to the second half of the sentence.
What he cares about is nothing more than the sentence, "There is nothing recorded on this bamboo slip."
He lowered his head in disbelief and unfolded the bamboo slips again to look at them. After a slight hesitation, he displayed them in front of the third elder and waved them.
These elders regarded him as one of their own, and his identity had been well protected so far, so he chose to believe them.
